[vc_row][vc_column][eikra-vc-text-title style="style2" title="Research Initiatives"][/eikra-vc-text-title][vc_column_text]Research Initiatives

The department of physics has taken initiatives of research and development in the field of Tribology. The works is in progress towards the design and development of trimesters and the evaluation of tribological properties of materials. The tribological properties of some high-performance polymers and composites are studied under heavy loading conditions.
